title: Greedy sampling designs via reduced basis methods: optimal recovery in the uniform norm
summary: We study optimal sampling recovery in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS) in the uniform norm. For every RKHS with bounded kernel, we establish new comparisons between linear sampling widths and Gelfand widths that overcome the known square-root gap, without requiring a measure or a Christoffel-type condition. Our bounds rely on nested sampling designs obtained by kernel interpolation at (weak) P-greedy points.
